profile.headline: Multimedia / Web Developer, Responsive & Web Designer, Internet Marketing,Professional Designer for Web & Multimedia
profile.geoLocationName: Egg Harbor, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
Creative individual dedicated to leveraging new and upcoming technologies for Mobile and Web applications to better serve my company and ensure we are applying the most up-to-date methods to communicate our goals online and beyond.

My ability to use responsive design for browser-based and mobile applications allow me to bring fresh opportunities to save money, while providing a more efficient communication and marketing approach. Additionally, my training as a Multimedia Specialist allows my company to leverage training content in a myriad of formats (audio, video and other online presentations), keeping our staff trained and up-to-date on the latest Healthcare trends.

My management and customer service experience provide a steady level of production as I wear many hats while working effectively in a team environment.  

Whether a Project requires me to take the lead, or simply complete a task, I can quickly adapt to fulfill my given duties and always offer additional assistance wherever it may be needed.

Specialties: User interface design, content management, branding, identity, mobile and web application architectures, advanced page layout and graphic design, project management, leveraging the web for communication, graphic design for print and web, application training.

positions.title: Multimedia / Web Developer
positions.description: Responsive / Mobile Web & Application design, user Interface Designer, specializing in Content Management Systems.  CMS Specialist, Multimedia design expert, focusing on new Mobile and Web Strategies for AtlantiCare.  Search Engine Optimization to leverage existing content ensuring AtlantiCare's offerings are easy to find online to first time visitors.  Video, audio editing and conversion of training materials.  Person-to-person training for intranet portal administrators allowing them to update their own content for their division or department.  Responsible for converting and editing numerous multimedia files (video and audio) for use on the Intranet and Internet web properties.

positions.title: Graphics Lead
positions.description:
As Graphics Lead I was responsible for designing and approving all online and print advertising for the company and our client base.
The client base was nationwide and consisted primarily of Auto Dealers looking to fill their Sales force with new and hungry salespeople.

Helped the company develop their own library of Sales Tools available for purchase on their website.
This library consisted of Audio CDs and Books all branded with the company design and logo.

positions.title: Owner/Graphic Designer/Muralist
positions.description:
Owner, designer of my own graphic design business for approximately 3 years in Northern California.  Assisting clients with new logos, web presence, search engine optimization and marketing for print and web.
Specializing in Content Management System websites to save clients money as they could perform day-to-day content updates and would only need to reach out to me in the case they had a large online Marketing campaign they needed to post in multiple, eye-catching formats.
Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop as well as Flash design and animation were widely used.

A traditional artist by nature, the "mural" side of the business allowed me to flex my creative juices a little more while designing custom murals for children's rooms.

positions.title: National Payroll Account Manager
positions.description:
As a National Account Manager, I was responsible for assisting payroll administrators with employee bases of 500 or more troubleshoot their payroll software.  Expedite last minute "special" payroll runs and finding reporting solutions to make the Payroll Administrator's job easier.
(My personal client base was approximately 20 accounts.)

The position required me to meet with the clients a few times a year to assist them and their payroll department with best practices, quarterly tax updates, amendments and filings, as well as possible opportunities for improvement on their current payroll process.

As one of the more well-rounded and customer service oriented Account Managers, I was frequently entrusted with high-maintenance clients for my ability to work hand-in-hand with them turning them into strong supporters of our company.

These accounts would get assigned to me for a period of 6 months until I could help them streamline their operations. At which point I would then turn them over to another Account Manager moving forward.

Also an avid volunteer and assisted with the creation of one of their first websites bringing online fundraising via the website.

projects.title: Website Responsive Design Creation
projects.description:
By changing the AtlantiCare Physician Group site from a static template and a secondary (scaled down) Mobile website, we reduced the number of FTEs required to maintain two separate sites and allowed all of the content present in the main site to be viewed in both the desktop and mobile environment.

Over a two-month period, I created the matching template and presented in a hidden environment that allowed Marketing to view the progress in both environments.

We followed this exact same procedure for two more out-of-market Urgent Care sites.
mountlaureluc.com  and crosskeysuc.com

Once the layout was approved, we went live with a seamless transition.

projects.title: AtlantiCare Physician Group Mobile Site
projects.description:
Created a mobile version of the AtlantiCare Physician Group website complete with an office locator based on geolocation that works with most smartphones created in the last 5 years.

Directions and distance to all Urgent Care, Family Medicine and Internal Medicine location can be found via the mobile site, listing the closest location first.

Mobile version site matches the standard website aesthetic while having a scaled down set of information available.

Visitors on smartphones that find AtlantiCare.org will automatically be redirected to the mobile site.
